insights.one_liner: Bosch Group's Dremel tools brand runs its EMEA headquarters in Breda, with English-friendly marketing internships for students.

culture.text: Dremel, part of Bosch, runs its marketing and sales headquarters for Europe, Middle East, Africa, Latin America and Asia Pacific from Breda.
Describes its working environment as young, where input and initiative from employees and interns is highly valued.
Its open roles here are two marketing and communications internships in Breda.

open.text: Both of its 2 open jobs here don't require Dutch.
Bosch Energy and Building Solutions B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor; it is unclear whether that covers the Dremel team.

growth.text: Bosch's profit margin slipped, pressured by weak car production and one-off charges.
Johnson Controls is selling its residential and light-commercial HVAC business to Bosch.
Bosch wants to build another factory in Romania.

worth_knowing.text: Bosch's appliance arm is closing a washing machine plant near Berlin, with job losses.
